title: structured-incident-timeline-exporter-and-brief-template-factory
author: Asha Kulkarni
description: Motivation: On-call handoffs and post-incident briefs often require a compact, machine-readable timeline that combines alerts, key traces, and remediation steps. Previously responders manually assembled timelines from disparate sources. This PR introduces two complementary capabilities: 1) a Structured Incident Timeline Exporter that composes a normalized, JSONL timeline from incident metadata, alert events, and selected telemetry snapshots; and 2) a Brief Template Factory that consumes a template catalog and instantiates a concise incident brief (markdown + attachments) populated with timeline snippets, top-ranked traces, and suggested playbook steps. Goals: reduce manual handoff time, make brief contents reproducible, and enable downstream automation (notebook replay, RCA scaffolding).

review_comments: Devon Park (2026-02-21): Nice shape — can you confirm the size bound on telemetry snapshots? We should avoid adding >1MB blobs to brief attachments by default.
Author Asha (2026-02-21): Snapshotter defaults to 256KB for handoff and has a --budget flag; added tests to assert budgets are respected.
Marcus Liu (2026-02-22): Template variables look flexible but we need a safe subset for user-provided templates to avoid leaking tokens; request explicit allowlist in factory.
Author Asha (2026-02-22): Implemented an allowlist and documented sanitization behavior; added unit tests covering variable resolution edge cases.
Priya Nair (2026-02-24): Integration tests flaked once on CI due to timeout when snapshotter tried to pull traces. Can we add retry/backoff and cap remote requests in tests?
Author Asha (2026-02-25): Added deterministic fixtures for tests and retry with exponential backoff for live trace pulls; re-ran CI and green.
Marcus Liu (2026-02-26): Approving — small nit on log level in exporter, prefer debug for per-event dump.
ci_checks: Integration: pass (retry after flaky trace pull)
Security-scan: pass (no new external exec or env leaks)
release_notes:
- Add structured incident timeline exporter (JSONL) for reproducible handoffs.
- Add brief template factory and example templates for quick on-call briefs.
- New CLI: rbx export-timeline and rbx render-brief.
- Telemetry snapshots constrained by default budget (256KB) with override flag.
- No breaking changes to existing incident APIs.
notes_on_rollout: Feature guarded behind feature-flag incident_briefing_v2. Rolling out to 10% of oncall channels for 48h, then 100% after metrics validation. Observability: new metrics exported incident_brief.templates_rendered and timeline.export.size_bytes. Alert if median export time > 750ms or median size > 400KB.
testing_and_validation: Unit and integration test suites added. Local smoke steps: 1) rbx export-timeline --incident=INC-1234 --out=sample.jsonl 2) rbx render-brief --template=pager-handoff --timeline=sample.jsonl --out=brief.md 3) open brief.md in briefViewer component sample. CI added deterministic fixtures to avoid flakiness.
